hypothesis: During Thanksgiving week, concrete proof and candid trade-offs persuade gaming-laptop shoppers better than a plain spec sheet or deadline pressure. Gift framing helps only with parents buying for a teenager, not with enthusiasts.

success_criteria.label: Measured-FPS proof beats the spec-sheet ad overall
The candid trade-off ad beats the urgency ad overall
Gift framing beats the spec-sheet ad with parents buying a gift
Measured-FPS proof beats gift framing with competitive enthusiasts
Urgency ranks below measured-FPS proof with budget students

A_spec_sheet.label: Spec sheet (control)
A_spec_sheet.text: HP Victus 15 gaming laptop with NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5050 (8GB), a 15.6-inch Full HD 144Hz display and a 512GB SSD. Thanksgiving price: $799.

B_proof_number.label: Measured proof
B_proof_number.text: 176 frames per second in Counter-Strike 2 at 1080p, Very High settings: that is what an independent lab measured on the HP Victus 15 with RTX 5050. Thanksgiving price: $799.

C_upgradable.label: Upgradeable
C_upgradable.text: Buy it now, upgrade it later. The HP Victus 15 has two RAM slots and two SSD slots, so more memory or storage means buying a part, not a new laptop. RTX 5050 graphics, 144Hz Full HD. Thanksgiving price: $799.

D_gift.label: Gift framing
D_gift.text: The Thanksgiving gift that works for school and for game night. HP Victus 15: RTX 5050 graphics, a 144Hz Full HD screen and room to upgrade. $799 from Thanksgiving through Cyber Monday.

E_honest_tradeoff.label: Candid trade-offs
E_honest_tradeoff.text: Plastic body. Modest screen colors. Serious RTX 5050 graphics for the money. The HP Victus 15 skips the premium finish so the budget goes to performance: 8GB RTX 5050, 144Hz Full HD, upgradeable RAM and SSD. Thanksgiving price: $799.

F_urgency.label: Urgency
F_urgency.text: BLACK FRIDAY DOORBUSTER! HP Victus 15 gaming laptop, only $799. Thanksgiving through Cyber Monday, then the price is gone. Don't miss out, hurry!
